Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates extensive bilateral consolidation with multiple cystic lucencies (pseudocavitation), a radiographic pattern highly characteristic of pneumonic-type lung adenocarcinoma (formerly bronchioloalveolar carcinoma). While pneumonia is a differential, the specific description of pseudocavitation within confluent consolidation strongly points to this malignancy in the context of such questions.
